contexts.text: By a shaving off of the hair, as with swine, they seem to become white.
When shaved, his strength departed (). Explained. AC 5247:4. DSS 49:3. AE 66:2.
The high priest... should not shave his head (); and so the Levites were not to shave their head (). Explained. AC 5247:2. AC 9960:5.
The dissipation of Divine good in the Heavens, is signified by to shave the head.
The prophet shaving off the hairs of his head and his beard () represented the state of the Jewish Church as to the Word. Explained.
The Nazarite was not to shave his hair (). Explained.
Not to shave the beard = not to deprive themselves of what is rational by taking away its ultimate...
